packageRules.description: Actions run with the deploy credentials, so an upstream release must not reach main without review
Ansible is not applied by CD, so a restic bump must be merged and applied by hand
prBodyNotes:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Ansible is not applied by CD. After merging, apply this from a machine on the tailnet:
>
> ```sh
> cd ansible && ansible-playbook playbooks/backup.yml
> ```
